about.title: About me
paragraphs: I am Neda Khanifar. My professional experience spans business development, international trade, market development and building commercial relationships. My work focuses on identifying trade opportunities, understanding market needs, winning customers, negotiating, and following each stage of a commercial agreement through to delivery.

Throughout my career I have worked in market research, identifying potential customers, direct marketing, product presentation and developing relationships with corporate clients. I also have experience negotiating with domestic and international customers, following up on commercial agreements, and coordinating between the parties involved to move orders forward.

In trade and export, I have hands-on experience with the full execution process: order registration and preparation of commercial documents, coordination of transport, customs follow-up, and communication with logistics providers. This has given me a practical view of how market development, sales and the fulfilment of commercial commitments connect.

My approach to business rests on market knowledge, effective communication, professional negotiation, accountability and consistent follow-up. I believe the real value of a business opportunity becomes clear only when it is brought to a result through planning, effective cooperation and precise execution.

Today my focus is on developing sustainable commercial partnerships, identifying new opportunities in regional and international markets, and taking part in projects where I can apply my experience in business development, trade and operational coordination.

items.title: Organiser and speaker, B2B seminar
items.text: Organised and spoke at a B2B trade seminar attended by more than 100 business and trade professionals. The Khuzestan Chamber of Commerce was a guest at the seminar.

items.title: Outstanding Young Person of Khuzestan
items.text: In 2023, Neda Khanifar was named in an IRNA report on the selection of the country's leading young figures from Khuzestan province. She was also honoured as one of the province's outstanding young people within the activities of Junior Chamber International (JCI).

items.title: Best booth, Ahvaz Agricultural Exhibition
items.text: Responsible for organising and running the booth, presenting products and dealing directly with customers and business people. The booth was awarded Best Booth at the close of the exhibition.
